name: Tiny ERP
description: Conector Tiny neutro e tenant-aware: leituras v2 nativas, writes v2/v3 somente em preview e fundacao OAuth v3 broker-backed.

files.kind: tenant configuration with broker connection reference and without secret values

migrations: SDE Tiny remains the enabled fallback until every live seam has parity, auth, quota and explicit cutover approval.

migration.operationScope: read wave 1: info plus low-risk contacts/products/stock; later read families remain on SDE
migration.credentialPolicy: tenant config references provider=tiny and connection=<tenant>; the broker persists encrypted v2 tokens or v3 OAuth bundles; hosts are pinned
migration.writeExecution: disabled; every mutating operation is schema-validated dry-run only

quota.retryPolicy: no live traffic; no retry until an official v1 contract is established

tiny.config-check.description: Valida a configuração isolada do tenant e a referência do broker sem resolver segredo.

help.summary: Valida a configuração Tiny e o estado público da conexão broker.

options.description: Tenant explícito; nunca há default implícito.

sections.title: NAO USE

options.description: Tenant explícito; nunca há default implícito.

sections.title: USE
sections.content: Auditar readiness OAuth v3 antes de consentimento/live.

sections.title: NAO USE
sections.content: Não materializa credencial, consentimento ou chamada Tiny.

sections.title: SEGURANCA
sections.content: READ-ONLY local; secretResolved=false e networkCalled=false.

sections.title: ON ERROR
sections.content: Tenant deve usar apiVersion v3 e --dry-run; conexão ausente permanece gap objetivo.

sections.title: AUTENTICACAO

sections.title: COTAS
